selection_rule: Maximum development outer-opener edit L1 increase, maximum verb oracle-KL increase, maximum object oracle-KL increase, and minimum sum of absolute changes across those three scores; deduplicate.
caveat: Ablation removes one functional first-layer token-score mode across all relative lags, not a native weight unit. The basis is fitted on separate unlabeled streams containing all task families. Only chosen modes are evaluated on the holdout.
